newsitem.title: USA: Cali Realty to acquire Robert Martin.
newsitem.headline: Cali Realty to acquire Robert Martin.

text.p: Real estate investment trust Cali Realty Corp said Monday it had entered into a $440 million agreement to acquire Robert Martin Co LLC.
Cali said it will pay $211 million cash, assume $185 million of debt, and issue $44 million in operating partnership units convertible into Cali common stock.
Cali said it expects the merger to be immediately accretive to its funds from operations (FFO), adding about $0.26 per share, or an increase of 12 percent from annualized 1996 third quarter FFO.
Robert Martin, headquartered in Elmsford, N.Y., is the largest real estate development company in the Westchester County (N.Y.) and Fairfield County (Conn.) region.
The privately-held firm owns and manages a core portfolio of over 4.1 million square feet of office and industrial space, Cali said.

As part of the deal, Brad Berger, Robert Martin's president and chief executive officer, and Tim Jones, Robert Martin's chief operating officer, will become part of Cali's management team as executive vice presidents, Cali said.
The deal is expected to close on or about January 31.
The combined company will operate as Cali Realty.
